## Dynamic Properties of Slopes {#sec-slope_periods}

{{< include /_chapters/ts.model.md >}}

```{r}
#| include: false
CAP <- readCaption("tbl.IDm")
HEADER <- "TSF Zone"
ZONE <- c(
  "Fine Tailings (Slimes, Pond)",
  "Coarse Tailings Beach / Upstream Shell",
  "Transitional Zone (Beach Margin / Intermediate Tailings)",
  "Rockfill Buttress / Downstream Shell",
  "Downstream Shell with Granular Filter or Transition Layer",
  "Downstream Shell with Fines-Enriched Transition / Filter",
  "Core Zone (Impervious Core / Cutoff Trench)",
  "Core Zone with Silty-Clay Transition (Core Margin / Fine Fill)"
)
```

{{< include /_chapters/dn.ensemble.md >}}

{{< include /_chapters/dn.model.md >}}

{{< include /_chapters/dn.uncertainty.md >}}

{{< include /_results/dn.inputs.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (nrow(SiteTable)) {
  NOTE <- .deckNote("gmdp", "Ground-Motion Design Parameters", "The Newmark displacement curves are developed in the %s annex.")
  if (nzchar(NOTE)) cat("\n\n", NOTE, "\n\n", sep = "")
  rm(NOTE)
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (nrow(SiteTable)) {
  NOTE <- .deckNote("gmdp", "Ground-Motion Design Parameters", "The seismic coefficients $k_{max}$ and $k_h$ are developed in the %s annex.")
  if (nzchar(NOTE)) cat("\n\n", NOTE, "\n\n", sep = "")
  rm(NOTE)
}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/kh.sites.qmd",
    stem = "kh-table",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(CAP = readCaption("tbl.kh.sites"), IDg.target = IDg.gmdp, IDm.target = IDm.gmdp),
    root = root,
    anchor = "sec-kh-table-site",
    context = "MCE kh table"
  )
}
rm(i, SiteTable)
```
